from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyHousingRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single monthly data point extracted from a housing construction report."""
    report_issue_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report was issued (YYYY-MM-DD format), used to determine precedence")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data point represents (YYYY-MM format)")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The seasonally adjusted count of units (magnitude)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale applied to the value (e.g. 'thousands')")
    region: str | None = Field(description="The geographic region covered by the data (e.g. 'United States')")
    housing_type: str | None = Field(description="The housing unit type (e.g. '1 unit' for single-family)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_records: list[MonthlyHousingRecord]
